description: This file contains implementation details for managing git submodule configurations, including cache handling, parsing from .gitmodules, and related utilities.

classes.name: submodule_cache
classes.description: Struct managing cached submodule configurations with hashmaps keyed by path and name.

classes.name: submodule_entry
classes.description: Wrapper struct representing an entry in the submodule cache hashmaps containing a submodule pointer.

classes.name: fetch_config
classes.description: Structure holding configuration options for fetching submodules, such as max children and recurse depth.

methods.name: unsigned int hash_oid_string(const struct object_id * oid,const char * string)
methods.description: Hash function combining object ID and string for caching purposes.

methods.name: void cache_put_path(struct submodule_cache * cache,struct submodule * submodule)
methods.description: Inserts a submodule into the cache keyed by its path.

methods.name: void cache_remove_path(struct submodule_cache * cache,struct submodule * submodule)
methods.description: Removes a submodule from the cache by its path.

methods.name: void cache_add(struct submodule_cache * cache,struct submodule * submodule)
methods.description: Adds a submodule to the cache keyed by its name.

methods.name: const struct submodule * cache_lookup_path(struct submodule_cache * cache,const struct object_id * gitmodules_oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Lookup a submodule in cache by its object ID and path.

methods.name: struct:submodule * cache_lookup_name(struct submodule_cache * cache,const struct object_id * gitmodules_oid,const char * name)
methods.description: Lookup a submodule in cache by its object ID and name.

methods.name: int check_submodule_name(const char * name)
methods.description: Validates a submodule name for illegal characters or sequences.

methods.name: int submodule_url_is_relative(const char * url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is relative, starting with ./ or ../.

methods.name: int count_leading_dotdots(const char * url,const char ** out)
methods.description: Counts leading '../' components in a URL, used for relative URL resolution.

methods.name: int url_to_curl_url(const char * url,const char ** out)
methods.description: Detects if a URL can be handled by git-remote-curl and retrieves the normalized URL.

methods.name: int check_submodule_url(const char * url)
methods.description: Performs validation on a submodule URL for security and correctness.

methods.name: int name_and_item_from_var(const char * var,struct strbuf * name,struct strbuf * item)
methods.description: Parses a configuration key to extract submodule name and item.

methods.name: struct:submodule * lookup_or_create_by_name(struct submodule_cache * cache,const struct object_id * gitmodules_oid,const char * name)
methods.description: Finds an existing submodule by name or creates a new one and caches it.

methods.name: int parse_fetch_recurse(const char * opt,const char * arg,int die_on_error)
methods.description: Parses recurse fetch options for submodules.

methods.name: int parse_submodule_fetchjobs(const char * var,const char * value,const struct key_value_info * kvi)
methods.description: Parses and validates the number of fetch jobs for submodules from config.

methods.name: int parse_fetch_recurse_submodules_arg(const char * opt,const char * arg)
methods.description: Wrapper that parses recurse submodule argument, ensuring validity.

methods.name: int parse_update_recurse(const char * opt,const char * arg,int die_on_error)
methods.description: Parses recurse update options for submodules.

methods.name: int parse_update_recurse_submodules_arg(const char * opt,const char * arg)
methods.description: Wrapper to parse recurse options when updating submodules.

methods.name: int parse_push_recurse(const char * opt,const char * arg,int die_on_error)
methods.description: Parses recurse options for push operations involving submodules.

methods.name: int parse_push_recurse_submodules_arg(const char * opt,const char * arg)
methods.description: Wrapper to parse recurse options for push operations.
